timer.texten: The caller was poisoned by smoke.

dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello, I need help! It's burning!
{WHAT'S BURNING?} I am sorry Ma'am what's burning?
It's burning! Send in the fire brigade immediately, please!
{CALM DOWN} Ok Ma'am I need you to calm down. What is burning?
My car! There's smoke coming from under the hood! Send firefighters!
{GET OUT OF THE CAR} What I want you to do is get away from your car. Do it as safely as you can ok?
{IS ANYONE HURT?} Is anyone hurt?
No, no one is hurt. Will you send help?!
{TRY TO PUT IT OUT} Did you try to put the fire out yourself?
Erm ... myself? No...
{USE AN EXTINGUISHER} Go to the trunk of your car take out the fire extinguisher and pull the pin.

dialogOption.emotions: [door sound and the street at the end]

dialogOption.texten: {USE IT ON THE ENGINE} Please pull the lever under the steering wheel to open the hood, and then spray the fire extinguisher onto the engine.
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . it worked, the fire is gone! I will call for roadside assistance... Thanks!
{NO PROBLEM}You're welcome.
{WHERE ARE YOU?} Ma'am where are you?
I'm near [[ADDRESS]]
Near Shell gas station at route 43
At Lake Street... 56
Near tall building on Seventh Street
{I'LL SEND THE FIREMEN} Ok, I'm sending the fire brigade.
Well, I'm waiting!
Hello, can you help me? My car is still on fire.

reportElement.texten: The driver was told to leave the car.
The operator has given helpful instructions. No intervention was needed.
The car has burned completely, and the driver was slightly poisoned by smoke
